articles.summary: HOUSTON, Nov. 11, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Evolution Petroleum Corporation (NYSE American: EPM) ("Evolution" or the "Company") today announced its financial and operating results for its fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2025. Evolution also declared its 14 th consecutive $0.12 cash dividend
articles.title: Evolution Petroleum Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2026 Results and Declares $0.12 per Share Quarterly Cash Dividend for the Fiscal Second Quarter
